note: Adapted from the new-species description of Mjöberg (1920), originally in English; the measurements in the original use commas as decimal points and have been changed to points; the soldier's “head length with mandibles” entry is unreadable owing to OCR residue and is omitted; the last worker measurement is given in the original only as breadth and is listed here as abdominal width according to the context; figure numbers, localities and collecting records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Yellowish white, flat, slender; head together with the mandibles reddish brown. Head flat, distinctly longer than wide, widest near the compound eyes, slightly narrowed towards the base; the anterior angles in front of the compound eyes projecting as obtuse angles, the posterior angles rounded. Clypeus wide, the apex rounded. Labrum large, convex, widest at the base, narrowed towards the apex, covering one third of the base of the mandibles, setose. Mandibles very long and pointed: the left mandible with 3 teeth, one of them very large and flattened, leaf-like, situated a little below the apex, immediately followed by a sharper tooth and further below by a smaller blunt tooth; the upper half of the right mandible with 2 smaller and less projecting teeth. Antennae arising from a deep, strongly sclerotized cleft, distinctly 16-segmented; the basal segment stout, segment 2 much smaller and narrower, segment 3 slightly longer than half of segment 2 and wider towards the apex, segment 4 shortest, segment 5 as long as segment 3, segments 6–16 gradually longer and thinner, the apical segment rounded at the tip; the apex and the base of each segment paler. Compound eyes appearing as transversely placed black patches, situated on the sides of the head slightly behind the antennal sockets. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, the anterior margin blunt, slightly arched at the middle, the anterior angles rounded, the sides sharply narrowed towards the apical margin, with several stiff hairs; mesothorax and metathorax distinctly wider. Legs rather short, the femora thickened, the tibiae slender. Abdomen long, parallel-sided and slender, the cerci and styli small. Measurements: body length 7.2 mm, head length (without mandibles) 2.8 mm, head width 1.52 mm, pronotal length 0.52 mm, pronotal width 0.91 mm, abdominal width 1.27 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Yellowish white, only the compound eyes and the sclerotized patch in front of the antennae dark brown. Head circular. Labrum large, convex, the apex rounded, completely covering the mandibles; mandibles as in the worker of S. queenslandicus in shape and colour. Antennae indistinctly 13-segmented, segment 1 stout, segments 2, 3 and 4 separated by indistinct sutures, segments 5–13 round and short, gradually longer segment by segment, the apical segment slender, parallel-sided and rounded at the tip. Pronotum distinctly wider than long, the anterior margin slightly arched, the anterior angles broadly rounded, the sides narrowed towards the posterior angles, the posterior angles completely rounded; the sides and the surface densely hairy. Femora thickened. Abdomen long, slender, densely hairy; cerci and styli small. Measurements: body length 6.4 mm, head length 1.18 mm, head width 1.08 mm, pronotal length 0.46 mm, pronotal width 0.76 mm, abdominal width 1.29 mm.
